goal: 设置页面入口图标，用于 HomeMenuPanel 进入 SettingsPanel

subject.concept: 齿轮/机械轮形状，代表系统设置与配置
subject.symbolism: 调节、控制、系统配置，VR环境参数设置

style.rendering: 线性图标（line icon），纯描边无填充

prompt: A minimalist line-art icon of a gear/cog wheel, showing a circular outline with 6 evenly spaced rectangular teeth protruding outward and a small circle in the center, single color #00B4D8 (cyan blue) on transparent background, 128x128 pixels, clean modern style, 2px uniform stroke with round linecap and linejoin, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, centered with 16px safe area padding, vector-style clean edges, simple and recognizable gear shape, suitable for VR medical training application
